2099-5034-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2099-5034-5660-6769.description:
Cast Sol Ring by paying its mana cost.
When Sol Ring enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sol Ring by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Sol Ring, giving Sarcatog +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Sol Ring from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

751-5295-6006.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

792-4279-5708--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-5708--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vein Ripper triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

222-527-1115-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-1115-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1011-2034-2728-5662.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
1011-2034-2728-5662.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
1011-2034-2728-5662.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Fate Transfer's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

345-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Metallic Mimic.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

1643-2073-3698-7878.description:
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning Clown Car from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Clown Car enters, Grinding Station and Kolodin trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Kolodin trigger, causing Clown Car to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Clown Car.
When Clown Car dies, Salvaging Station triggers, untapping Salvaging Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability.
Repeat.

1863-3946-7804.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

997-1619-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
997-1619-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
997-1619-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

1308-4050-5086-5183-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
1308-4050-5086-5183-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 1.

1445-4478-5477.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one creature card in your hand.
You have at least one creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4478-5477.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning any other creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

423-433-1437-5233--85.easyPrerequisites: Myojin of Cryptic Dreams has at least two indestructible counters on it.
423-433-1437-5233--85.description:
Cast Llanowar Scout by paying {1}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Myojin of Cryptic Dreams by removing an indestructible counter from it, copying the Llanowar Scout spell three times.
Resolve the first Llanowar Scout copy.
Activate the Llanowar Scout token by tapping it, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Evolution Sage.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Evolution Sage trigger, putting an indestructible counter on Myojin of Cryptic Dreams.
Repeat from step 3 two additional times.
Repeat from step 2.

5742-5743-6753-7178.description:
Activate Iron-Shield Elf by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Iron-Shield Elf ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4927-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4927-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

270-1183-4853.description:
Activate Hedron Archive by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Pentavus's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
When the Pentavite dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Hedron Archive.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-5434-5555-7046.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
997-5434-5555-7046.description:
Donate Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2239-3542-3647.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
2239-3542-3647.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Displace by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Palinchron
When Ardent Elementalist and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Ardent Elementalist trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
2239-3542-3647.notes: If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

864-972-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
864-972-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness and the Great Whale token.
When the Eternal Witness and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
864-972-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Eternal Witness instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

671-2173-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
671-2173-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Daxos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Daxos trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Goblin Firestarter enters, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1251-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1456-1987-2364-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault by tapping them, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Mana Vault.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

2034-2835-3490-6822.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2034-2835-3490-6822.description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Fecundity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1021-5231-6620-6761.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six land cards in your graveyard.
1021-5231-6620-6761.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing Drownyard Temple.
Each Scouring Swarm you control triggers, creating a tapped token copy of itself.
Resolve the Sylvan Safekeeper ability.
If you control four or more Scouring Swarms, activate Thermopod by sacrificing a Scouring Swarm, adding {R}.
Repeat step 4 until you control three Scouring Swarms or until you have {3} available, whichever comes first.
Activate Drownyard Temple by paying {3}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
1021-5231-6620-6761.notes: The mana cost assumes you control no other Scouring Swarms. If you control one other Scouring Swarm, the cost is reduced to {2}. If you control two or more, the cost is {0}. To get infinite Scouring Swarms, you will need to control at least four at one time. If you wish to achieve this, only sacrifice Scouring Swarms if you control five or more of them. This raises the total cost of the combo by {1} assuming you start with only one Scouring Swarm.

1453-1947-3327-4613.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1453-1947-3327-4613.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Activate Dargo using Reckless Barbarian's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

1283-2816-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {3} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
1283-2816-3918.notes: You can use Chromatic Orrery's second ability to draw cards if mana allows.

5200-6266.easyPrerequisites:
Redshift, Rocketeer Chief does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Redshift.
5200-6266.description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Redshift.
Repeat.

428-3090-3604-5096.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-3090-3604-5096.description:
Cast Harmless Offering by paying {2}{R}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Cast Ghyrson Starn by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Ghyrson Starn enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

requires.n: Artifact Creature with Mana Cost X and Toughness 0

218-1295-1368-5400--39.notablePrerequisites: Synth Infiltrator is a copy of Diligent Excavator.
218-1295-1368-5400--39.description:
Cast the artifact creature from your hand by paying {0}.
Diligent Excavator and Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill four cards.
The artifact creature enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Cast the artifact creature from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {0} and exiling any three cards from your graveyard, except Thassa's Oracle if it is in your graveyard.
Repeat from step 2 until you have an empty library.
If Thassa's Oracle is in your hand, cast it by paying {U}{U}.
Otherwise, cast Thassa's Oracle  from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {U}{U} and exiling three cards from your graveyard.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield, causing you to win the game.

1235-4867-5195.description:
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Twinflame, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself, returning Twinflame from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1636-2778-2857.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2778-2857.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Wall of Stolen Identity by paying {3}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Wall of Stolen Identity.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Wall of Stolen Identity into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Wall of Stolen Identity to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

698-3169-4050-4770.notablePrerequisites:
You have gained at least 1 life this turn.
Will does not have summoning sickness.
Genesis Chamber is untapped.
698-3169-4050-4770.description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of all white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {1}.
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {W} due to Will's ability.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2.

902-3259-4068.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a Mountain.
You have visited at least one Attraction this turn.
902-3259-4068.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squirrel Squatters as attackers.
Squirrel Squatters triggers, creating at least one 1/1 Squirrel creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Squirrel token, untap all creatures you control and get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

245-2267-2476-2836.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight cards in hand.
245-2267-2476-2836.description:
Move to your cleanup step, discarding down to your maximum hand size.
Bag of Holding triggers for each card discarded this way.
Resolve the first Bag of Holding trigger, exiling the discarded card.
Tormod triggers, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card, or win the game if your library is empty.
Discard down to your maximum hand size.
Repeat from step 2.

939-2499-2792-4404.notablePrerequisites: Panharmonicon on the battlefield.You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}.
939-2499-2792-4404.description:
Cast Soul Foundry by paying {4}.
Soul Foundry enters the battlefield, triggering its imprint ability twice, exiling Great Whale and Corridor Monitor.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Activate Soul Foundry by paying {9} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Whale and Corridor Monitor.
The Great Whale and Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice.
Resolve both Corridor Monitor triggers, untapping Soul Foundry.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.

752-914-1927-3094.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
752-914-1927-3094.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{W}.
Cast Leave by paying {1}{W}.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying Leave.
Resolve the copy of Leave, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lithoform Engine from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least ten Treasure tokens.
Activate nine Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {8}{R}.
Cast Lithoform Engine by paying {4}.
Repeat from step 5.

1335-2034-3129.notablePrerequisites: Marath has at least three +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2034-3129.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Elemental, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marath by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from itself, putting two +1/+1 counters on itself.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to get infinite +1/+1 counters on Marath and choose to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
